text:
Alex: Planning to start a gradual canary for inference-service @ 18:00 UTC today. Who can own deploy + smoke? target cohorts: 1% → 5% → 20% over 30m intervals. Need rollback ready. Ping if you can.
Neha: @Alex I can own the deploy window. Are we using geo-based cohorts or percent buckets?
Alex: Percent buckets for this one. geo excluded. Cohorts: 1%, 4%, 15% then 20. We'll pause at each step for 10m smoke.
Samir: I can run the smoke checks and validate latency/5xx. Will be on-call.
Lucas: Prep notes: make sure kv-cache warmers are preloaded. Also confirm model variant pinned v2.1-quant. I pushed config:
```bash
deployctl rollout start --service inference-service --variant v2.1-quant --strategy gradual \
  --steps \"1,5,20\" --interval \"00:30:00\" --verify \"smoke-script.sh\"
```
Maya: smoke script (samir):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# quick smoke
curl -sS -XPOST https://api.redwood.int/infer -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
# latency check
curl -w "%{time_total}" -sS https://api.redwood.int/health
```
Samir: I'll run the script from jumpbox and post results per step. If >200ms p50 or >0.5% 5xx we rollback. Agreed?
Neha: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also add alert for token-cost spike threshold.
Alex: Rollback plan: immediate abort rollout and route traffic back to v2.0-stable; ops will open a rollback PR and tag @infra. Documented in runbook.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: rollout/inf-v2.1-quant by @Neha scheduled at 18:00 UTC. CI checks passed.
Samir: I'll be available 17:45-19:00 UTC. tagging runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollouts
Lucas: One more ask: throttle batch size to 8 during ramp. Added canary flag in config.
Neha: Got it. I'll start at 18:00 and DM when first 1% step is live.
Alex: Thanks team. Last check: anyone needs a rehearse before go?
Maya: No, we're good. :rocket:
